title: Productization sprint for model adoption and release operations
creator: Aisha Kline
description: Define and run a compact productization sprint to take a newly vetted open model from intake -> public availability. This ticket coordinates release notes, benchmark publication, console catalog entry, SDK examples, and comms for developer audiences. The emphasis is a repeatable sequence and checks so future model additions follow the same verification and comms runway.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entry published with model metadata, tags, and cost profile
Benchmark report uploaded to onboarding docs and linked in the catalog
Release notes drafted, reviewed by Eng/Security/Docs, and staged for publication
SDK sample and quickstart verified against hosted API and included in docs
Comms package (blog blurb, changelog entry, support FAQ) approved and scheduled
checklist: Intake: confirm license and export controls clearance (Legal)
Compatibility: verify model signature and tokenization parity with runtime
Performance: run standard throughput/latency suite across supported hardware profiles
Quality: run evaluation prompts and adversarial set; record regressions >2%
Cost: produce per-inference cost estimate using Optimize profiles
Catalog: craft title, short description, tags, model size, recommended use-cases
Documentation: create Quickstart, SDK snippet, parameter guidance, safety notes
Benchmarks: generate reproducible benchmark artifact (scripts + results) and link to the report
Release notes: write blurb, list breaking changes, migration guidance, and known issues
Console: add model tile, beta flag if gated, and observability defaults
Rollout plan: canary cohort, A/B metric targets, fallback model mapping
Support: publish sample prompts and troubleshooting steps in internal KB
Comms: prepare blog draft, press kit, and social cards for marketing
Launch smoke: coordinate a 24-hour pre-launch and 72-hour post-launch rota across Eng/SE/Support
rollback_criteria: Observed latency p95 > 2x expected for the selected dedicated tier
Error rate on generation endpoints increases >3% relative to baseline
Critical security finding surfaced during pre-launch pen test
release_notes_blurb: Added support for an open LLM variant optimized for chat and instruction-following. The model offers a low-latency configuration for short-turn conversations and an alternative quantized variant for cost-sensitive workloads. See the catalog entry for benchmarks, example prompts, and SDK snippets.
notes: We are using the new benchmark harness (version 2.1) for reproducibility. Initial perf runs show 12% lower throughput on A100-80GB in our config; runtime team is investigating kernel tuning. Docs draft is 80% complete; marketing requires final blurb by 2026-03-15 to keep the planned press window.
